question: We have three trade offers pending, all proposed by us, and all three send Trey Murphy III and Fred VanVleet. Only one can execute. Which one should we keep pending (withdrawing the other two), or should we withdraw all three? (A) Derrick White + RJ Barrett from Dr White Slong, for Murphy + VanVleet, expires 31 Oct 06:39 UTC. (B) James Harden from Team Nic Kerr, for VanVleet + Murphy, expires 31 Oct 06:41 UTC. (C) Anthony Edwards from Melbourne poopoo, for VanVleet + Murphy + Kawhi Leonard, expires 31 Oct 21:59 UTC.
constraints: The owner: Fred VanVleet is not a consideration in trades at all; give his value no weight either way.

ballots.rationale: With VanVleet's slot treated as replacement level, B is Harden for Murphy straight, and Harden leads on every lens: +3.51 FP/g on 2026 actuals (45.11 vs 41.60), +5.81 on projection plus blind spot (43.70 vs 37.89), and +3.2 this season (29.8 in 5 games vs 26.6 in 5). That is about +335 to +561 FP rest of season whatever replacement level we assume. White + Barrett (38.35 + 32.98) beat Murphy plus a free agent only on 4-game samples: Barrett's 2026 rate is below six free agents, and his 40.5 is a bump while Kawhi is out. Edwards ranges from -446 to +580 depending on assumptions, on an unresolved post-surgery timetable (ESPN est. 21 Dec, possibly January).
